column1: # PSGopher - which N64 games use the Expansion Pak (the extra 4 MB: 8 MB in all), and which must run without it.
# docs/dev/expansion-pak.md has the sources, their licences and how each entry was made.
#   key         a game code ("NXXE": the header's four letters, category, game, destination), a game code and
#               the header's revision byte ("NXXE-01", hexadecimal: library.h's gameKey), or the cartridge's
#   status      required      the game does not work, or most of it is missing, without the Expansion Pak
#               enhanced      the game uses it for more (high resolution, replays, more players) and runs without
#               incompatible  the game misbehaves with 8 MB: it must run with the Jumper Pak (4 MB)
#   sources     where the status comes from (docs/dev/expansion-pak.md): nintendo, wikipedia, pj64, m64p
#   confidence  verified     two independent sources agree
#               cited        one source, which names its own sources
#               unverified   one source, and a weak one
# A game that is not here is "not listed": Auto leaves the Expansion Pak on (Gopher64's default).
